设计意图： Further smoothing the drawdown stress factor with a 10-day moving average reduces high-frequency noise, targeting improved ICIR and RankICIR consistency while preserving the core tail-risk mechanism. The increased smoothing window is expected to yield more stable cross-sectional ranking without materially weakening rank signal strength.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(ts_mean(divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), 60)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 14)), 10), )
  2. 2. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), 60)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 14)), 10)
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), 60)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 14))
  4. 4. ts_min —— 过去 N 天滚动最小值
    ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), 60)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 60))
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 60))
  7. 7. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)
  8. 8. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjHigh, 60)
  9. 9. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 14)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 peak_high：high.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close - peak_high) / peak_high
  3. 计算 max_drawdown：drawdown.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).min()
  4. 计算 atr：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=14)
  5. 计算 stress：-max_drawdown / atr
  6. 计算 factor：stress.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).mean()
  7. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_stress_extra_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak_high = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = (df_copy["str">'close'] - peak_high) / peak_high.replace(0, np.nan) max_drawdown = drawdown.rolling(60, min_periods=60).min() atr = talib.ATR(df_copy["str">'high'], df_copy["str">'low'], df_copy["str">'close'], timeperiod=14) stress = -max_drawdown / atr.replace(0, np.nan) factor = stress.rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean() factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0) df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_stress_extra_smoothed'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_stress_extra_smoothed']
